messages:
maria: Draft ready for final review — aiming to publish Tue 3/23 10am PT. Need final approvals on headline, benchmark callouts, and lead-routing.
ben: Sending now, thx. Quick question: which CTA should we use — 'Try Redwood' or 'See benchmarks'? Both need different UTMs.
zoe: Prefer 'See benchmarks' for launch to capture research leads. 'Try Redwood' can be in the follow-up email.
liam: Legal: I need the exact benchmark methodology blurb before signoff. Any claims about cost/latency need attribution.
maria: Copy snippet below — pls flag edits

```
Headline: Redwood Inference: Consistent, low-latency LLM serving across hosted and private deployments
Lead: Today we’re launching Redwood Inference — a dev-first inference platform that makes production-scale LLM serving predictable, economical, and secure.
Benchmark callout: In our internal tests, Redwood reduced median token latency by 30% vs baseline and cut per-token cost by ~20% for conversational workloads (see methodology).
```

anya: I'm fine with wording but prefer 'reduced median token latency by up to 30%' to avoid absolute phrasing. Also need a link to the methodology doc.
ben: Added suggested UTM sets. Publishing link should use:

```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=redwood_inference_2026
```

and for webinar CTA:

```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=redwood_webinar_q2
```

zoe: For lead routing, route blog CTA leads to HubSpot list 'launch_benchmarks_2026' with lifecycle stage=MQL.
liam: Ops: send an event webhook to /hooks/marketing/leads with payload: `source=blog, campaign=redwood_inference_2026` — devs will pick it up.
maria: @liam @zoe can you confirm HubSpot mapping and webhook by EOD? Also, timeline: publish Tue 10am PT, social schedule at 10:15.
ben: Legal note: don't promise 'cost savings' without qualifier. If methodology doc includes numbers, we can keep the % with 'internal tests'.
legal-bot: Automated check: No restricted words flagged. Please attach methodology link for final review.
zoe: I'll attach methodology and update the line to 'in internal tests, up to 30% lower median token latency vs. our baseline' and ping legal.
maria: Thanks — if legal signs off, we greenlight scheduling. Approvals: @ben, @zoe, @liam, @anya, @legal-bot — please react with :white_check_mark: when good.
ben: :white_check_mark:
zoe: :white_check_mark:
liam: :white_check_mark:
anya: :white_check_mark:
legal-bot: :white_check_mark: (timestamped)
maria: Great — final publish time confirmed. I'll queue post and the email nurture flow.
